previous_selected10_independent_finding.title: Unrelated native frames default to ownership by the currently active caller
previous_selected10_independent_finding.trigger: A qualified native thread/task/loop site belonging to another owner occurs while one original input is active.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.defect: caller_for returns thread_actor_callers.get(tid, active) when no genuine cli/agent/context/host/result-tool match exists. That fallback assigns resources/tails to the active caller without an original owner/context witness, and persistent thread-ID mappings are not retired by generation. Ledger witness may subsequently reject a foreign context, but other thread/loop/tail rows are still attributed and joined as caller-owned.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.change: Require exact retained constructor/context/thread/task generation correlation for each caller attribution. Represent unmatched/foreign resources separately as unknown; do not infer ownership from temporal overlap or reused TID, and never join a resource as caller-owned solely from that fallback.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.qualification: Static attribution defect; all native/foreign-generation orchestration remains NOT_RUN.

current_selected11_author_repair.rationale: Exact retained original frame ancestry plus actual thread/task objects and caller generation, or genuine retained context/resource witness. No active-temporal/TID fallback. Unmatched/foreign resources separate, generations retire; unowned/preexisting threads never joined as caller-owned.
